summary: Coder AgentとReviewer Agentの相互同意を防ぐため、fresh-contextの独立verifier subagent・決定的なtest/typecheck oracle・敵対的（反証）role設定を用い、Reviewerには生成物だけでなく仕様と実行証拠を渡す。

evidence.summary: 『Separate, fresh-context verifier subagents tend to outperform self-critique.』一定間隔で仕様に対しsubagent検証する指示を推奨。
競合仮説を互いに反証させるdebate構造（anchoring回避）と、review観点を分けた並列reviewer。
trajectory/artifactのsample監査でreward hacking・不当passを検出（evidence-supported）。
AI reviewを人間判断の完全代替にしない（失敗対策として明記）。
誤検証9.1%・検証欠落8.2%: 検証Agentが表層checkに留まる失敗が主要mode。

code-review (public, reputation established): read SKILL.md: it pins a fixed point, locates the originating issue/spec, then spawns Standards and Spec sub-agents in parallel — each receiving the diff command, commit list and its own source material — explicitly 'so they don't pollute each other's context', and reports the two axes separately without merging.

applies_when: 生成と検証を別Agentに分ける構成
reviewerが同じ会話文脈・同じ前提を共有している
not_applicable_when: 決定的testで判定可能な変更（Agent reviewer自体が不要）
applicability.model_conditions: fresh-context verifier優位はFable 5でAnthropicが観測。他modelは一般則として候補

expected_effect.primary: 生成側前提を共有した形式的承認を減らし、実欠陥検出率を上げる
metrics: 独立verifierが差し戻した割合
人間reviewで後から見つかった欠陥数

risks: verifierも同じmodel biasを共有し得る（決定的oracle併用が必要）
cost: verifier subagent定義と検証間隔の指示
known_failure_modes: reviewer LGTMを人間reviewの代替にする

matched_on: reviewers run as separate sub-agents so they do not pollute each other's context
the reviewer is given the originating spec plus the diff and commit list, not just the artifact
review axes are kept separate so one cannot mask the other, and findings are not re-ranked

alternates.why_not_primary: Equally direct on fresh context ('the reviewer gets precisely crafted context for evaluation — never your session's history') and passes plan/requirements plus base and head SHAs; a close second, chosen against only because code-review is already installed here and additionally splits spec from standards.

Explicitly adversarial fresh-context review with a bounded reviewer prompt (files, diff, invariants, one review question, output shape) and 'findings are hypotheses, verify against source' — matches the adversarial half, but this id was not returned by the skills.sh queries run, only confirmed in the repository.
